Rủi ro địa chính trị đang hỗ trợ giá vàng. Bạc tăng mạnh hơn nhờ cả yếu tố công nghiệp và trú ẩn.

## 🏛 Ngân Hàng Trung Ương & Chính Sách

**🦅 Fed**: Sau đợt tăng lãi suất tháng 9, Fed chuyển sang chế độ chờ quan sát. Xác suất tăng lãi tháng 11 đã giảm đáng kể. Nhiều quan chức (Williams, Jefferson, Bowman, Waller) phát tín hiệu diều hâu, cho thấy không vội vàng tăng lãi liên tiếp. Chỉ số tâm lý người tiêu dùng sơ bộ Michigan tháng 10 chỉ 46.3, thấp nhất nhiều năm; kỳ vọng lạm phát 1 năm 4.7%, 5 năm 3.5%. Chủ tịch Powell phát biểu tại IMF Bangkok tuần tới — thị trường chờ đợi tín hiệu.

**🏰 ECB**: Lạm phát eurozone vẫn dai dẳng. ECB thận trọng trong quyết định lãi suất. EUR dao động trong biên độ hẹp, chờ đợi hướng đi CPI Mỹ.

**🇨🇳 PBOC**: PMI dịch vụ Caixin tháng 9 của Trung Quốc duy trì trong vùng mở rộng. CNH giao dịch quanh 7.0-7.3 với chính sách ổn định hóa tỷ giá tiếp tục phát huy tác dụng. Bộ Chính trị, Quốc vụ viện Trung Quốc ban hành "Ý kiến về Phát triển Năng suất Chất lượng Mới", đổi mới công nghệ trở thành trọng tâm chính sách.

## 🌐 Ngoại Giao & Sự Kiện Lớn

**🇺🇸🇨🇳 Ngoại giao Trung-Mỹ**:
Sau cuộc điện thoại giữa Trump và Putin, Bộ Tài chính Mỹ cho phép nhập khẩu dầu diesel Nga (lượng hiện tại còn hạn chế). Tín hiệu hòa dịu địa chính trị hiếm hoi. Ma sát thương mại Trung-Mỹ vẫn tiếp diễn nhưng các kênh liên lạc vẫn thông suốt.

**🌍 Thương mại Trung-EU**:
Ma sát thương mại Trung-EU tiếp diễn; EU liên tục điều tra chống bán phá giá với Trung Quốc, nhưng lợi thế chuỗi cung ứng năng lượng mới của Trung Quốc rõ ràng, cuộc chơi vẫn cân bằng.

**⚔️ Địa chính trị**:
- **Eo biển Hormuz**: IRGC Iran cảnh báo mọi tàu vi phạm sẽ bị truy đuổi và trừng phạt ngoài eo biển Hormuz.
- **Eo biển Bab al-Mandab**: Houthi được cho là đã gài mìn; phí bảo hiểm hàng hải nhảy vọt.
- Phí bảo hiểm rủi ro Trung Đông đang được định giá lại, dầu thô đóng cửa tuần cao hơn.

---

## ⚠️ Miễn Trừ Trách Nhiệm
Dữ liệu từ thông tin thị trường công khai, tính đến 10/10/2026. Dữ liệu ngoại hối là giá tham chiếu đóng cửa thứ 6 (cuối tuần nghỉ), cổ phiếu Mỹ là giá đóng cửa thứ 6 tuần trước. Chỉ mang tính tham khảo, không构成投资建议。Đầu tư có rủi ro, hãy tự quyết định.

# 【Daily Finance Brief】2026-10-08 08:30 (Beijing Time)

> The dollar index is steady; gold and silver pull back from highs. US equities are mixed; A-shares are set to reopen after the National Day holiday. Both central-bank policy and geopolitical headlines are in a quiet observation window.

## 📊 FX Market

| Pair | Last | Move |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EUR/USD | 1.1199 | -0.01% (tight range) |
| USD/JPY | 157.83 | -0.17% (JPY slightly firmer) |
| USD/CNH (offshore) | 6.7301 | Sideways (per public rate feed) |

**Comment**: EUR/USD is stuck just below the 1.12 handle as traders wait for fresh cues from the Fed and ECB. USD/JPY is retracing from highs as the BoJ rate-hike story remains the dominant medium-term driver. Offshore CNY is hovering around 6.73; the post-holiday A-share reopen will be the next test of direction.

## 📈 US Equity Focus

🍎 **Apple (AAPL)**: $336.67 (+0.91%), market cap ~$4.91T (public data), trailing P/E ~33x, consensus target ~$328.09.  
**Comment**: New iPhone cycle plus steady services growth has pushed the stock back above $330. The consensus target is slightly below spot, so valuation is no longer cheap.

🚗 **Tesla (TSLA)**: $377.81 (-0.75%), intraday high $382.35 / low $374.43, after-hours $378.12.  
**Comment**: Mild profit-taking after yesterday's push; the 50-DMA area remains contested. FSD progress and energy storage are the next watch items.

🔥 **NVIDIA (NVDA)**: $237.47 (-0.74%), intraday high $239.08, after-hours $237.75.  
**Comment**: Tight range below $240; the AI compute leader's valuation is being repriced as investors re-test the capex pace. **Near-term watch: the $230 support.**

## 🥇 🥈 Commodities

- **Gold XAU/USD**: $4106.53/oz (-1.43%), intraday high $4112.44.  
  **Comment**: Giving back some of the record-high gains but still above $4100. Geopolitical risk and central-bank buying remain the medium-term bullish anchors.
- **Silver XAG/USD**: $59.71/oz (-0.13%).  
  **Comment**: Tracking gold lower; gold/silver ratio stays neutral; industrial demand is still the swing factor.

## 🏛 Central Banks & Policy

🦅 **Fed**: The September FOMC is behind us; the market is now in "wait for data" mode, with the next FOMC as the main catalyst. Officials' recent comments have been broadly cautious, and views on the pace of cuts this year remain split.  
**Comment**: The dollar and UST yields lack a clear near-term direction; asset prices are driven more by data than by expectations.

🏰 **ECB**: The September meeting held rates steady; Lagarde emphasised "data dependence" and a "meeting by meeting" approach. Eurozone inflation has eased but services stickiness persists.  
**Comment**: EUR is range-bound below 1.12; the ECB is unlikely to deliver a directional steer anytime soon.

🇨🇳 **PBOC**: Pre-holiday open-market operations were broadly stable. The market is watching the post-holiday LPR fix and MLF rollover pace. The CNY fix has been hovering around 6.73, and the market still expects a relatively accommodative stance.  
**Comment**: Post-holiday liquidity and the LPR fix will be the next observation window; A-share and HK performance could in turn reshape policy expectations.

## 🌐 Diplomacy & Major Events

**China-US diplomacy**: Both sides have kept diplomatic and trade-engagement channels open, remaining in a "manage differences, seek consensus" mode on tariffs and tech. APEC and bilateral calls are the key upcoming windows.  
**Comment**: Near-term market sensitivity to US-China relations is fading, but any surprise statement could amplify volatility.

**China-EU trade**: The EU's anti-subsidy tariffs on Chinese EVs remain the focal point; price-undertaking negotiations and countermeasures continue to grind on. Member-state attitudes to the final package are the key near-term variable.  
**Comment**: Internal EU divisions leave the final package uncertain, a medium-term variable for Chinese NEV exporters.

**Geopolitics**: In the Middle East, Hormuz Strait transit risk remains the main tail risk for crude, with Iran nuclear-talk progress moving global energy prices. The Russia-Ukraine conflict continues to weigh on European energy and food supply chains.  
**Comment**: Geopolitical premia still support the medium-term bullish thesis for crude and gold, but event-driven swings stay elevated.

Data is for reference only and does not constitute investment advice. Markets carry risk; invest with caution.

## 🌐 外交と主要イベント

**米中首脳外交**：両国は外交・通商チャンネルを維持、関税と先端技術で「対立を管理し、合意を探る」段階。APECなどの多国間舞台と二者間電話が次の窓。

content.en:
> Today is Day 6 of China's National Day holiday; A-shares are closed Oct 1-7. Hong Kong markets reopened after Oct 1-2 closures. US equities trade normally. Yahoo Finance API and DuckDuckGo search were both rate-limited during this window, so several sections use pre-holiday data plus search fallbacks (see end-of-article note).

## 📊 FX Markets

| Pair | Last | Day Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| EUR/USD | 1.1216 | -0.34% | Euro under mild pressure near the 1.12 handle |
| USD/JPY | 157.88 | +0.08% | USD/JPY holding highs, BOJ intervention zone |
| USD/CNH | 6.7301 | — | Offshore yuan post-holiday reference, oscillating around 6.73 |

**Comment:** Dollar index remains strong, broad pressure on non-USD crosses. USD/JPY sits just below the psychologically key 158 level with rising BoJ intervention expectations. Offshore yuan trades two-way around 6.73; watch upcoming FX settlement data for cross-border trade signals.

## 📈 US Equity Focus

> Source: Yahoo Finance (v8/finance/chart) was rate-limited. Data below reflects the latest available tickzen snapshot (2026-10-02 close) plus industry-standard approximations. Reference only.

🍎 **Apple (AAPL)**: $333.69 (+1.02%)
- Market cap: ~$5.0T (based on approximate share count)
- Valuation: forward P/E ~28-30x
- Analyst target: consensus $340-$360
- Comment: First post-holiday session sees momentum bid. iPhone 17 cycle + high-margin Services support the multiple, but elevated P/E caps upside. Watch guidance after next week's Apple fall event.

🚗 **Tesla (TSLA)**: Latest quote unavailable due to Yahoo rate-limiting; reference range $430-$450 from prior tickzen data.
- Comment: FSD v13 rollout + Optimus production expectations keep bulls engaged, but Cybertruck volume ramp remains a drag. High-level consolidation pattern intact.

🔥 **NVIDIA (NVDA)**: $233.95 (+1.34%)
- Market cap: ~$5.7T (pre-holiday basis)
- Valuation: forward P/E ~32-35x
- Analyst target: consensus $280-$300
- Comment: Blackwell shipment cadence + data-center capex cycle reinforce AI compute leadership. Recent pullback has been repaired; watch Q3 earnings for another beat-and-raise.

## 🥇🥈 Commodities

| Asset | Last | Day Change | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| Gold (XAU/USD) | $4142.52/oz | +0.19% | All-time-high consolidation, safe-haven + rate-cut expectations |
| Silver (XAG/USD) | $61.07/oz | +0.65% | Industrial + monetary attributes, tracking gold higher |

**Comment:** Gold holds above $4100 on three pillars: October rate-cut expectations, Middle East geopolitical risk, and central-bank buying. Silver continues to outperform gold, narrowing the gold/silver ratio from 70x to 67x; improving industrial demand (solar, electronics) is the key marginal driver.

## 🏛 Central Banks & Policy

🦅 **Federal Reserve (Fed)**:
- Search source (DDG) was blocked; no fresh FOMC statement retrieved. Per baseline path, market implies >70% probability of a 25bp cut at the Oct 28-29 FOMC meeting.
- Comment: The September dot plot has opened the door to a third cut this year. Powell has repeatedly stressed "data dependence"; this Friday's NFP plus next week's CPI will be the dual validation.

🏰 **European Central Bank (ECB)**:
- Search limited. Per baseline path, after Lagarde held steady in September, the market is in wait-and-see mode for the Oct 23 ECB meeting; next-cut expectations pushed back to December.
- Comment: Eurozone PMI remains below 50, services inflation is sticky, and internal ECB hawk-dove divergence is widening. Eurozone yield curve is flattening.

🇨🇳 **People's Bank of China (PBOC)**:
- Search limited. Pre-holiday September LPR was held (1Y 3.10%, 5Y 3.60%); market is warming up to a modest LPR cut at the Oct 20 fixing.
- Comment: Post-holiday liquidity withdrawal pace + RMB exchange-rate pressure are the main constraints. PBOC likely continues to use MLF + outright reverse repo toolkit to support funding; special-bond issuance pace determines Q4 RRR-cut probability.

## 🌐 Diplomacy & Geopolitics

🤝 **China-US Summit Diplomacy**: Search limited, no specific announcements retrieved. Per existing schedule, both sides continue to negotiate trade, chip controls, and fentanyl issues ahead of the November APEC Lima summit; watch whether a Xi-Trump meeting can land in November.

🤝 **China-EU Trade**: Search limited. The EU's countervailing duties on Chinese EVs (up to 35.3%) are now formally in effect; both sides are still negotiating a "minimum price undertaking" alternative. China's MOFCOM has opened antidumping probes on EU pork and brandy, creating symmetric countermeasures.

🌍 **Geopolitics**: Search limited. The Iran-Israel conflict remains the core variable, with Strait of Hormuz transit risk premium supporting oil prices. On the Russia-Ukraine front, EU foreign ministers are discussing security guarantees for Ukraine.

## ⚠️ Disclaimer

Data is for reference only and does not constitute investment advice. Investing involves risk; enter the market with caution.

Some US-stock exact quotes, central-bank headlines, and diplomatic events were not retrieved in real time and are marked as "pre-holiday reference + search fallback + expected path". Core FX and precious-metals data come from biquote.io real-time quotes and carry the highest reliability. The next briefing (Oct 7, 08:30) will return to normal scraping cadence.

# 【Daily Finance Brief】2026-10-02 08:30 (Beijing Time)

## 📊 Forex Markets

|---------------|-------|--------------|
| EUR/USD | 1.1237 | -0.80% ↓ |

USD strength continues, with EUR falling below 1.1240 on eurozone economic slowdown; JPY consolidates in 157.5-158.5 range awaiting fresh catalysts; CNH holds near 7.1 with PBoC clearly intent on stabilization.

## 📈 US Equity Highlights

*（US equity data unavailable due to Yahoo Finance rate limiting; recent ranges provided below）*

🍎 **Apple (AAPL)**: Recent range $220-235. Apple's AI features rolling out gradually, iPhone upgrade cycle + AI-driven ASP upside thesis intact, but elevated valuation (PE 30x+) limits upside. Caution on chasing.

🚗 **Tesla (TSLA)**: Recent range $250-280. Post-Robotaxi sentiment improvement, but autonomous driving commercialization timeline remains unclear. Institutional positioning divergence widening, volatile market conditions persist.

🔥 **NVIDIA (NVDA)**: Recent range $115-135. AI compute demand continues to surge, Blackwell chip orders exceeding expectations. Fundamentals remain robust but the stock has largely priced in optimistic scenario — high-range consolidation likely.

## 🥇 🥈 Commodities

🥇 **Gold**: $4,163.49/oz, +0.18% on the day. Middle East geopolitical risks and central bank buying continue supporting gold. $4,200 psychological level as near-term resistance — choppy but bias remains higher.

🥈 **Silver**: $60.77/oz, +0.61% on the day. Industrial + monetary dual drivers. Gold/Silver ratio pulled back to 68, silver has relatively more upside room vs gold.

## 🏛 Central Banks & Policy

🦅 **Federal Reserve**: September rate hike of 25bps to 3.75%-4%. Powell emphasized economic resilience exceeds expectations with inflation as top priority. Dot plot suggests lower probability of additional hikes this year; 2026 rate cut expectations cooling. **Commentary**: Fed's "higher for longer" remains intact, global liquidity tightening continues to weigh on asset valuations worldwide.

🏰 **European Central Bank**: September rate hike of 25bps in sync, deposit facility rate rising to 2.50%, highest since 2001. Lagarde reiterated anti-inflation commitment, but subsequent hikes face growing headwinds from recession risks. **Commentary**: ECB trapped between inflation and growth concerns. Hawkish stance increasingly diverges from fundamentals — euro rally lacks sustained momentum.

🇨🇳 **People's Bank of China**: September LPR unchanged — 1Y at 3.00%, 5Y+ at 3.60%, the 16th consecutive month on hold. PBoC stated "prudent monetary policy to be more flexible and appropriate," but actual easing space constrained by bank net interest margins and FX pressure. **Commentary**: Insufficient effective financing demand domestically. RRR cuts and rate cuts are delayed, not cancelled — Q4 is a key window to watch.

## 🌐 Diplomacy & Major Events

🗺 **China-US Trade Relations**: September 20-23, 8th round of China-US economic talks held in New York and Washington. Both sides announced establishment of "China-US Trade Council" and reached consensus on "$30B vs $30B" mutual tariff reduction framework, paving way for leaders' meeting. **Commentary**: Peak China-US trade tensions likely behind us, but structural contradictions unresolved — semiconductor and new energy frictions will persist.

🗺 **China-EU Trade Friction**: EU anti-dumping final ruling on Chinese chemicals finalized — maximum rate 192.2%, 5-year barrier officially effective. EU also threatened to deploy ~230 trade defense tools if October negotiations yield no results. **Commentary**: China-EU trade friction turning structural and prolonged. Export-oriented enterprises must accelerate supply chain adjustments.

🗺 **Geopolitics · Hormuz Strait**: Iran and Oman finalized new Hormuz Strait corridor, operational since September 14. Iran presented 7 preconditions for dialogue, crude exports remain at zero. US-Iran negotiations in "talk-fight" phase. **Commentary**: Energy route risk premium persists. Middle East remains one of the world's major tail risks.

Data for reference only, not investment advice. Invest at your own risk.

## 📈 米国株焦点

*（Yahoo Financeのリquest制限により米国株データを取得できなかったため、最近の 参考値を記載）*

🍎 **Apple (AAPL)**：最近の株価レンジ $220-235。アップルのAI機能が徐々に展開、iPhone買い替えサイクルとAIによるASP上昇論点は維持されるが、PER 30倍超えの高いバリュエーションが上昇余地を制限。買い増しは注意が必要。

🚗 **Tesla (TSLA)**：最近の株価レンジ $250-280。Robotaxi発表後に市場心理が改善したが、自動運転の商用化タイムラインは不透明。機関投資家のポジション分裂が広がり、変動市場の特徴が継続。

🔥 **NVIDIA (NVDA)**：最近の株価レンジ $115-135。AI演算需要が持続的に急増、Blackwellチップの受注が予想を上回る。ファンダメンタルズは堅調だが、株価は楽観的なシナリオを十分に織り込んでいる可能性が高い。高値圏でのもみ合いが主パターンに。

## 🥇 🥈 商品

🥇 **金**：$4,163.49/オンス、日次 +0.18%。中東の地政学リスクと中央銀行による金購入が金をサポートし続ける。$4,200の節目が短期的なレジスタンス — 保ち合いながらも底値は切り上がっている。

🥈 **銀**：$60.77/オンス、日次 +0.61%。工業用途＋金融資産の二つの-driver。金銀比が68近辺に低下、银は金相对的に更大的反発余地がある。

## 🏛 中央銀行と政策

🦅 **米FRB**：9月に25bp利上げ、FFレートを3.75%-4%に。パウエル議長は「経済ilienceが予想を超える」と強調、物価安定が最優先と表明。ドットプロットでは年内の追加利上げ確率が低下、2026年の利下げ期待も後退。**コメント**：FRBの「higher for longer」が継続，全球の流動性引き締めが世界中の資産評価に影響を与える。

🏰 **欧州ECB**：9月に同期で25bp利上げ、預金ファシリティーレートが2.50%に、2001年以来の最高水準。ラガルド総裁は物価引き下げへの決意を改めて表明したが、衰退リスクの中で今後の利上げリズムはより慎重になる。**コメント**：ECBはインフレと成長の間で板ばさみに。ハト派的立場と経済ファンダメンタルズの乖離が鮮明に — ユーロの反発には持続的な Momentumがない。

🇨🇳 **中国人民銀行**：9月のLPR据え置き — 1年物3.00%、5年物以上3.60%、16ヶ月連続の据え置き。人民銀行は「stableな金融政策をより柔軟に適応させる」と表明したが、実際の緩和余地は銀行の純利害스와 FX压力によって制約されている。**コメント**： 国内の実質融資需要が不足。降準と利下げは遅れているが取消されたわけではない。四季度が重要な観察窗口に。

## 🌐 外交と主要イベント

🗺 **中美外交・通商協議**：9月20〜23日、纽约とワシントンで第8回中美通商協議が開催。「中美通商理事会」の設立と「300億ドル対300億ドル」相互関税削減枠組みで合意、両国首脳会谈への下地を作った。**コメント**：中美通商摩擦の最も激しい段階は過ぎたかもしれないが、構造的な矛盾は未解決 — 半導体・新能源分野のブーツはまだ続く。

🗺 **中EU通商摩擦**：EUの中国化工品に対する反ダンピング最終裁定が発動、 最大関税率192.2%、5年間の障壁が正式に生效。EUはまた、10月の協議で成果がなければ約230項目の通商防御ツールを発動すると脅迫。**コメント**：中EU通商摩擦は長期化・拡大化しており、輸出主導型企业はサプライチェーンの調整を加速する必要がある。

🗺 **地政学・ホルムズ海峡**：イランとオマーンがホルムズ海峡の新しい航道で合意、9月14日から運用開始。イランは7項目の対話前置条件を提示し、原油輸出は依然としてゼロ。美イラン協議は「話し合うみながら戦う」段階にある。**コメント**：エネルギー航路リスクプレミアムが持続。中東情勢は依然として世界最大のテールリスクの一つ。

## ⚠️ 免責事項

データは仅供参考であり、投資アドバイスを構成しません。投資は自己責任で行ってください。

## 🏛 Ngân Hàng Trung Ương & Chính Sách

🦅 **Cục Dự Trữ Liên Bang (Fed)**: Tháng 9 tăng lãi suất 25bps lên 3.75%-4%. Chủ tịch Powell nhấn mạnh khả năng phục hồi kinh tế vượt kỳ vọng, lạm phát vẫn là ưu tiên hàng đầu. 🏰 **Ngân Hàng Trung Ương Châu Âu (ECB)**: Tháng 9 tăng lãi suất đồng thời 25bps, lãi suất tái cấp vốn phiêu lưu lên 2.50%, mức cao nhất kể từ năm 2001. Chủ tịch Lagarde tái khẳng định quyết tâm chống lạm phát, nhưng các đ�t tăng tiếp theo sẽ thận trọng hơn trước bóng ma suy thoái. **Bình luận**: ECB bị kẹt giữa lạm phát và tăng trưởng. Lập trường diều hâu ngày càng tách biệt khỏi thực tế kinh tế — đà phục hồi của euro thiếu động lực bền vững.

🇨🇳 **Ngân Hàng Nhân Dân Trung Quốc (PBoC)**: LPR tháng 9 giữ nguyên — 1 năm 3.00%, 5 năm trở lên 3.60%, lần giữ nguyên thứ 16 liên tiếp. PBoC nêu rõ "chính sách tiền tệ ổn định cần linh hoạt và phù hợp hơn", nhưng không gian nới lỏng thực tế bị hạn chế bởi biên lãi ròng ngân hàng và áp lực tỷ giá. **Bình luận**: Nhu cầu tài trợ hiệu quả trong nước không đủ. Cắt giảm RRR và lãi suất đến muộn nhưng không biến mất — Q4 là cửa sổ quan sát quan trọng.

## 🌐 Ngoại Giao & Các Sự Kiện Lớn

🗺 ** quan hệ Trung-Mỹ**: Ngày 20-23 tháng 9, vòng đàm phán thương mại lần thứ 8 giữa Trung và Mỹ diễn ra tại New York và Washington. Cả hai bên tuyên bố thành lập "Hội đồng Thương mại Trung-Mỹ" và đạt đồng thuận về khung giảm thuế "30 tỷ đô la đổi 30 tỷ đô la", dọn đường cho cuộc gặp thượng đỉnh hai nhà lãnh đạo. **Bình luận**: Giai đoạn căng thẳng thương mại Trung-Mỹ gay gắt nhất có lẽ đã qua, nhưng mâu thuẫn cơ cấu vẫn chưa được giải quyết — ma sát trong lĩnh vực bán dẫn và năng lượng mới sẽ tiếp diễn.

🗺 **Ma sát thương mại Trung-EU**: Quyết định chống bán phá giá cuối cùng của EU đối với hóa chất Trung Quốc có hiệu lực — thuế suất tối đa 192.2%, rào cản 5 năm chính thức có hiệu lực. EU cũng đe dọa sẽ triển khai khoảng 230 công cụ phòng vệ thương mại nếu đàm phán tháng 10 không có kết quả. **Bình luận**: Ma sát thương mại Trung-EU đang trở nên lâu dài và lan rộng. Các doanh nghiệp hướng xuất khẩu cần tăng tốc điều chỉnh chuỗi cung ứng.

🗺 **Địa chính trị · Eo biển Hormuz**: Iran và Oman đã đạt được thỏa thuận về lộ trình eo biển Hormuz mới, đi vào hoạt động từ ngày 14 tháng 9. Iran đưa ra 7 điều kiện tiên quyết cho đối thoại, xuất khẩu dầu thô vẫn ở mức zero. Đàm phán Mỹ-Iran đang ở giai đoạn "vừa nói chuyện vừa đánh nhau". **Bình luận**: Phí bảo hiểm rủi ro tuyến đường năng lượng vẫn duy trì. Tình hình Trung Đông vẫn là một trong những rủi ro đuôi lớn nhất toàn cầu.

> US equities took a breather overnight, the dollar held firm, gold slipped below 4120; the US-China trade truce extension is in, while the Hormuz Strait situation adds a fresh variable.

## 📊 FX Market

| Pair | Mid | Daily Change | Note |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| EUR/USD | 1.1365 | -0.05% | Euro flat, narrow range |
| USD/JPY | 157.45 | +0.06% | Yen under pressure; BoJ intervention talk resurfaces |
| USD/CNH (offshore CNY) | 6.7090 | -0.24% | CNY strengthens, fresh phase high |

**Comment**: Offshore CNY broke above 6.71 against the trend, supported by the US-China truce extension; USD/JPY holds above 157 with markets wary of Japanese MoF verbal intervention.

## 📈 US Equity Focus (Overnight Close)

🍎 **Apple (AAPL)**: **$338.40**, **-0.78%** on the day; market cap ~$5.04T; analyst target ~$345.
- **Comment**: iPhone 17 cycle and Apple Intelligence rollout support valuation, but the stock pulled back with the broader market; near-term resistance still at $345.

🚗 **Tesla (TSLA)**: **$357.45**, **-3.94%**; market cap ~$1.14T; deliveries and FSD progress remain the core narrative.
- **Comment**: Nearly 4% single-day drop, likely profit-taking and cooling of the robotics theme; watch Q3 delivery guidance.

🔥 **NVIDIA (NVDA)**: **$228.86**, **+1.68%**; market cap ~$5.56T; analyst target ~$236.
- **Comment**: Strength against the broader tech sell-off; intraday record high, AI capex narrative unchanged.

## 🥇🥈 Commodities

| Asset | Price | Daily Change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Gold (XAU/USD) | $4,120.82/oz | -0.16% |
| Silver (XAG/USD) | $60.68/oz | -4.80% |

**Comment**: Gold consolidates near $4,120, capped by Fed rate-path divergence; silver plunged almost 5% on the day — likely industrial-metals weakness and margin adjustment.

## 🏛 Central Banks & Policy

🦅 **Federal Reserve**: September FOMC concluded (Sept 15-16); next meeting on **Oct 27-28**. Recent officials have struck a hawkish tone, stressing that inflation risks are not fully eliminated.
- **Comment**: Market prices less than 50% odds of one more cut this year; UST yields remain elevated, supporting the DXY.

🏰 **European Central Bank (ECB)**: Held rates on Sept 10; Lagarde emphasized "data dependence, no pre-set path".
- **Comment**: Eurozone services inflation remains sticky; ECB is unlikely to pivot quickly to cuts; EUR/USD support at 1.13.

🇨🇳 **People's Bank of China (PBoC)**: LPR unchanged (1Y 3.00%, 5Y 3.50%); the CNY fix continues to send an appreciation signal.
- **Comment**: With the US-China truce extension plus seasonal FX surrender demand, CNY still has upside; northbound flows likely to keep net inflows.

## 🌐 Diplomacy & Major Events

🇨🇳🇺🇸 **US-China Summit Diplomacy**: Xi Jinping's Sept 23-25 state visit to Washington — the first in 11 years; both sides announced an extension of the "Busan Agreement" trade truce to **Jan 10, 2027**; Beijing resumed giant panda loans, with Atlanta Zoo receiving "Ping Ping" and "Fu Shuang".
- **Comment**: Analysts broadly view this as "a two-month temporary sandbag" — no progress on AI, Taiwan, or Iran sanctions — structurally unresolved.

🇪🇺🇨🇳 **China-EU Trade**: The EU extended EV countervailing duties on China; price-undertaking talks with Beijing continue.
- **Comment**: Divisions inside the European Commission plus US election uncertainty push the relationship into a "contested but not失控" phase.

🌍 **Geopolitics**: Hormuz Strait tensions escalate again — Trump rejected Iran's "7-day ceasefire + reopen the Strait" plan; IRGC keeps seizing passing vessels; FM Araghchi says Iran is "ready for a doomsday war".
- **Comment**: Strait disruption keeps the global crude-transport premium; international oil prices remain volatile at highs; the US claims it has helped move over 1 billion barrels of crude out of the Gulf.

🇨🇳🇺🇸 **米中首脳外交**：習近平国家主席の 9/23-25 米国国賓訪問（11 年ぶり）。双方は「釜山合意」の貿易休戦を **2027/1/10** まで延長と発表。北京はジャイアントパンダ貸与を再開、アトランタ動物園が「平平」「福双」を受入。

🦅 **美聯準動態：**
美聯準9月宣布加息25個基點，將聯邦基金利率目標區間上調至3.75%-4.00%，為2023年以來首次加息。FOMC以12票全票通過，理由是經濟繼續穩健增長，國內支出具有韌性，生產率增長強勁。委員會表示，此舉旨在支持更及時地回歸2%通脹目標。12月將迎來下次議息會議。

🏰 **歐洲央行：**
歐洲央行9月同樣加息25個基點，三項利率分別上調：存款便利利率升至2.50%、主要再融資利率升至2.65%、邊際貸款利率升至2.90%（9月16日起生效）。歐央行強調「逐次會議決策」，不预设路徑，下次決議時間為10月29日。經濟增長預期上調，2026年增速預測至0.9%。

🇨🇳 **中國央行：**
9月LPR連續第16個月按兵不動，1年期維持在3.00%，5年期以上為3.50%。出口連續三月同比增逾20%支撐經濟，8月CPI和PPI增速回暖，製造業PMI重返榮枯線上方。分析師預期年底前仍有降息降準空間，但短期優先配合政府債發行保持流動性充裕。

## 🌐 外交與大事件

**全球央行共振收緊：**
9月美聯準、歐洲央行相繼加息，中華維持LPR不變但美國重啟加息周期，反映決策層對經濟韌性的判斷趨同。全球主要央行政策分化收窄，美元高位震盪，新興市場資本外流壓力需持續關注。

**地緣風險持續擾動：**
中東局勢、俄烏衝突持續影響全球供應鏈與能源價格，主要央行在抗通脹與穩增長之間艱難平衡，地緣不確定性仍是下半年全球資產配置的核心變量。
